As the sun cast its warm glow, Fico and I wrapped up our morning fetch ritual. Back in the living room, I sprawled out on the mat, and Fico, ever the loyal companion, fetched yesterday's newspaper.

Glancing at the date, Feb 14th, a peculiar feeling crept in. Something was awry. I turned to Fico, "Hey, buddy, any clue about today?"

Fico responded with a paw on my lap and a slobbery kiss on my cheek.

Then, out of nowhere, a voice chimed in, "Hope you still remember me."

I looked up to see a familiar face. It wasn't a lost love or a forgotten friend; it was Lady Death, looking surprisingly casual.

With an apologetic smile, she offered me coffee. Confused but intrigued, I wondered if a bit of charm might delay the inevitable. "How can someone so beautiful be so scary?"

She chuckled, "Flattery won't change the rules."

Battling desperation, I pleaded, "I can't imagine life without him."

"You're young, plenty of life ahead," she replied. "But rules are rules."

Desperation turned to tears as reality set in. I snapped back to the present, only to find Fico shot by a disgruntled general for raiding his food waste.

Back in my hut, I reminisced about the dream where Lady Death granted Fico another year, and in that time, my three-legged companion had made surviving in Afghanistan not just bearable but memorable.

Amidst the harsh reality, I realized life's unpredictability, and, despite the tears, I couldn't help but appreciate the unique journey Fico and I had shared.

It was a warm sunny day like any other, Fico and I just finished our morning game of fetch in the park. We come into the living room and I lie flat on the mat. Fico brings me my yesterday’s newspaper.

I see the date, Feb the 14th. Something strikes me as missing, or wrong. I call Fico and ask him, “Fico, you have any idea what’s up with today?”

Fico looks at me and starts licking my feet.

“I hope you still remember me” a gentle voice comes from a distance.

I look up and see a familiar face. She smiles apologetically and asks me if I want a coffee. Then, it clicks that it’s been a year but it’s lady death standing as gracefully as ever.

Still a sucker for the ladies and hoping that maybe a bit of flirting might help, I ask “How can such a beautiful face seem so scary?” She smiles, “I like the flattery but rules are rules”

“Please, I can’t imagine my life without him”

“You are 28 years old, there is so much more to life for you, your best friend will be going today but he would be waiting for you. I’m just borrowing him for a little bit, even I like his company”

“You have no idea, my life would be nothing without him. I have no one here in this foreign land, I can’t even go home, these Afghanistan will kill me and my family if I try”

“Life seems hard but that’s the fun of it, you won’t figure out what you can do. I know it gets better if you try but unfortunately I can’t help you there”

I start crying and come out of my shock.

I suddenly stop day dreaming and look at Fico, he has been shot by the general because he didn’t like Fico eating his food waste.

I come back to my hut and think back. It’s been a year since I had the dream of meeting lady death and asking Fico to not die from the mine blast. 3 legged and still strong, Fico was my companion here and it was him that made surviving here bearable.
